title: Provider team
subtitle: Who administers this installation, with which role and in which tenants.
loadError: The team could not be loaded.
ownersOnly: Only owners can change the team.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Everything, including the team, the license and the installation settings.

administrator.label: Administrator
administrator.description: Sets up and runs tenants, storage, schedules, sources and integrations. Not the team, the license or the installation settings.

technician.label: Technician
technician.description: Runs backups, checks and restores and opens backed-up and archived content. Changes no configuration.

read_only.label: Read only
read_only.description: Sees status, reports and the audit log. No content, no changes.
